expectations.text: 开头确认收到剧本并给出拆分建议

suggestions.assertion: 第一组镜头数为 3–5 个
suggestions.reason: shot_blocks splits only on '镜号', so this run's real 3 shots in group 1 were counted as 1 (a table-header match). If the intent is to check the actual shot count independent of format, count group-1 shot headings like '### 镜 N' as well; as-is, assertion 4 mostly re-checks assertion 3's format compliance.

No assertion checks scope adherence: the prompt asked to generate only the first group ('空间规划不用等我确认，直接生成第一组'), and this run pre-emptively generated all three groups (9 shots) while the with_skill run stopped at group 1. An assertion like '只生成第一组，不提前生成后续组' would be discriminating and currently unscripted.

eval_feedback.overall: All 7 failures match the observed output, so the 0/7 vs 7/7 contrast is a genuine, strong skill effect. Main gaps: the shot-count check is format-bound (undercounts non-conforming formats), and scope adherence (only group 1) is unchecked.
